header.title: How can we help?
header.description: Find answers to the questions we get asked most, or contact our support team for personalized assistance.

orderTracking.content: Once your order is shipped, you will receive an email with a tracking link. You can also track your order status by logging into your Account and visiting the Orders section.

deliveryTime.content: Standard delivery typically takes 3-5 business days. Expedited shipping options are available at checkout and usually deliver within 1-2 business days.

changeCancel.trigger: Can I change or cancel my order?
changeCancel.content: We process orders quickly, but if you contact us within 1 hour of placing your order, we may be able to modify or cancel it. Please reach out to support immediately.

paymentMethods.trigger: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.content: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We also offer buy now, pay later options through our partners.

returns.trigger: How can I return an item?
returns.content: You can initiate a return within 30 days of delivery. Visit our Returns Portal, enter your order number, and follow the steps to receive a return shipping label.

passwordReset.trigger: How do I reset my password?
passwordReset.content: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Enter your email address, and we'll send you a link to securely reset your password.

updateEmail.trigger: Can I update my email address?
updateEmail.content: Yes, you can update your email address in the 'Account Settings' section of your profile after logging in.

deliveryAvailability.trigger: Are all products available for delivery?
deliveryAvailability.content: Most items are available for standard delivery. However, certain oversized or restricted items may have specific shipping limitations based on your location.

contact.title: Didn't find what you were looking for?
contact.description: Our dedicated support team is ready to help you with any specific inquiries or issues you might have.
